description: Changes an account's persona (up to 4,000 characters), schedule_times (comma-separated HH:MM in the account time zone, up to 8), review_before_publish, auto_reply_enabled, auto_thread, auto_link_to_comment, enabled, random posting (random_schedule, random_per_day, random_window, and random_exclude: up to 3 ranges such as 17:00-18:00 that random times skip), and content_rules (max_chars, min_chars, forbid_cta, forbid_hashtags, banned_phrases, facts as the only numbers the AI may use, forbid_causal_claims, judge_claims, one_fact_per_post, mention_limits, enforce warn or block). Only the fields sent are changed, except content_rules, which is replaced as a whole. if_match (the guardrails etag) makes a concurrent change answer 412 instead of overwriting; reason (up to 200 characters) is stored in the revision; dry_run:true previews whether the change would apply, ask the owner or be denied, without writing anything. A change that loosens a guardrail may wait for the owner's confirmation. Applies when the user asks to change voice, posting times, review mode, auto-reply or content rules.

auto_reply_enabled.description: AI replies to comments on own posts

content_rules.description: Structured rules: max_chars, min_chars, forbid_cta, forbid_hashtags, banned_phrases[], facts[] (allowed numbers as plain sentences), forbid_causal_claims, judge_claims (model reviews for unsupported conclusions), one_fact_per_post, mention_limits [{phrase,max}], enforce (warn|block). null clears.

dry_run.description: true = preview only (1.9.0); at most 10 a minute per key

random_exclude.description: Up to 3 HH:MM-HH:MM ranges random times skip, no midnight crossing, no overlap; [] clears

random_schedule.description: Random times every day instead of schedule_times (1.21.0)

random_window.description: HH:MM-HH:MM, start before end; 00:00-23:59 = whole day
